subject: DI04019011

h.en: 2.1.1 Pressure is useful, compression costs work

body.en:
Start with the situation

A factory compressor supplies tools and actuators; air leaks and unnecessary pressure make the electricity bill rise.

Definition / principle

An air compressor raises air pressure by work input. Positive-displacement machines trap volumes; dynamic machines add velocity and convert part of it into pressure.

Understand why

Classify by principle, number of stages, cooling, lubrication and delivery condition. Selection depends on flow, pressure, purity, duty cycle and efficiency.

Application / illustration

Reciprocating machines suit many high-pressure duties; rotary/dynamic choices depend on their actual performance range and required flow.

Common mistake / conditions

Use absolute pressures in pressure ratios and thermodynamic equations; gauge pressure readings must be converted.

Does stage splitting without cooling guarantee work saving?

No. Not in the continuous equal-exponent ideal path; intercooling is what changes inlet temperature.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Factory compressor tools,actuatorsને air આપે;leaks,બિનજરૂરી pressureથી electricity bill વધે.

Definition / Principle

Air compressor work inputથી air pressure વધારે.Positive-displacementમાં volume trap થાય;dynamicમાં velocity ઉમેરી તેનો ભાગ pressureમાં ફેરવાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Principle,stages,cooling,lubrication,delivery conditionથી classify કરો.Selectionમાં flow,pressure,purity,duty cycle,efficiency જુઓ.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Reciprocating અનેક high-pressure dutiesમાં યોગ્ય;rotary/dynamic selection actual performance range,flow પર આધારિત.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Pressure ratio,thermodynamic equationsમાં absolute pressures લો;gauge readings convert કરો.

Cooling વગર Stage Splitથી Work Saving પાકી?

ના.Continuous equal-exponent ideal pathમાં નહિ;intercooling inlet temperature બદલે છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A piston changes cylinder volume; automatic valves admit and discharge air as pressure differences permit.

Construction:part and purpose

Cylinder and piston enclose the working air volume.

Crank, connecting rod and drive convert rotation to reciprocation.

Suction and delivery non-return valves respond to pressure difference.

Clearance volume remains at the piston end for mechanical/valve space.

Cooling jacket/fins, lubrication as designed and a rated receiver/relief system support operation.

Working:flow and reason

Residual clearance air first re-expands until cylinder pressure falls to suction pressure.

Suction valve then opens and fresh air enters during the remaining outward stroke.

On the return stroke both valves close and trapped air is compressed.

When cylinder pressure exceeds delivery-line pressure sufficiently, the delivery valve opens.

Air is discharged; clearance air remains and the cycle repeats.

Common mistake / conditions

The compressor indicated cycle contains suction/discharge flow; it is not simply a closed-mass compression curve. Water/oil carry-over and receiver safety need qualified controls.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Piston cylinder volume બદલે;pressure difference મુજબ automatic valves air લે/છોડે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Cylinder,piston working air volume બનાવે.

Crank,connecting rod,drive rotationને reciprocationમાં ફેરવે.

Suction,delivery non-return valves pressure differenceથી ચાલે.

Piston end પર mechanical/valve space માટે clearance volume રહે.

Designed cooling jacket/fins,lubrication,rated receiver/relief system operationને ટેકો આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Residual clearance air પહેલાં re-expand થઈ cylinder pressure suction સુધી લાવે.

પછી suction valve ખૂલે,બાકી outward strokeમાં fresh air આવે.

Return strokeમાં valves બંધ, trapped air compress થાય.

Cylinder pressure delivery-line કરતાં પૂરતું વધે ત્યારે delivery valve ખૂલે.

Air discharge થાય,clearance air રહે,cycle repeat થાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Indicated cycleમાં suction/discharge flow છે;ફક્ત closed-mass compression curve નહિ.Water/oil carry-over,receiver safety માટે qualified controls જોઈએ.

body.en:
Understand why

Compression connects suction closure to delivery opening; delivery occurs near high line pressure; clearance re-expansion falls toward suction pressure; fresh suction fills the remaining volume.

Ideal indicated loop area is net indicated work per cycle under the adopted sign convention; real valves/flow produce pressure losses, heating and departures from ideal constant-pressure lines.

Common mistake / conditions

Swept volume is piston displacement; fresh intake at suction conditions is smaller when clearance re-expansion and other losses occur.

Does more clearance improve fresh intake?

Usually not. It requires more re-expansion before suction in the stated model.
body.gu:
કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Compression suction closureથી delivery opening જોડે;delivery high line pressure નજીક;clearance re-expansion suction તરફ;બાકી volumeમાં fresh suction થાય.

Adopted sign conventionમાં ideal indicated loop area net indicated work per cycle છે.Real valves/flowથી pressure losses,heating,ideal constant-pressure linesથી deviations થાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Swept volume piston displacement છે;clearance re-expansion,અન્ય lossesથી fresh intake suction conditionsમાં ઓછું મળે.

વધુ Clearanceથી Fresh Intake સુધરે?

સામાન્ય રીતે નહિ.Stated modelમાં suction પહેલાં વધુ re-expansion જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

For ideal reversible isothermal air compression:win=R T1 ln(p2/p1).For ideal polytropic steady-flow compression:p v^n=constant, win=n/(n−1)R T1[(p2/p1)^((n−1)/n)−1].

T2=T1(p2/p1)^((n−1)/n).Ideal isentropic work usesn=gamma. For air in these examplesR=.287kJ/(kg·K), gamma1.4.

Common mistake / conditions

These input-work formulas include the flow-compressor context. Do not use closed-system boundary-work magnitudeRT Delta/(n−1) without the required factor/model.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Ideal reversible isothermal air compressionમાં win=R T1 ln(p2/p1).Ideal polytropic steady-flow compression p v^n=constant માટે win=n/(n−1)R T1[(p2/p1)^((n−1)/n)−1].

T2=T1(p2/p1)^((n−1)/n).Ideal isentropic workમાં n=gamma.આ examplesમાં air માટે R=.287kJ/(kg·K),gamma1.4.

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ input-work formulas flow-compressor contextના છે.Required factor/model વગર closed-system boundary-work magnitude RT Delta/(n−1) ન વાપરો.

h.en: 2.1.5 Compression work, outlet temperature and power

body.en:
Given and model

Airp1=1bar absolute, p2=8bar absolute, T1=300K, n1.3, m.1kg/s, R.287kJ/(kg·K).

Step-by-step solution

  1. T2=300×8^(.3/1.3)=484.7598K
  2. win=(1.3/.3)×.287×300×[8^(.3/1.3)−1]=229.7797kJ/kg
  3. Indicated ideal-model power=.1×229.7797=22.9780kW
  4. Isothermal minimum under stated endpoints= .287×300×ln8=179.0399kJ/kg

Common mistake / conditions

Values follow the assumed constant-property polytropic model, not a measured compressor map.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Air p1=1bar absolute,p2=8bar absolute,T1=300K,n1.3,m.1kg/s,R.287kJ/(kg·K).

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. T2=300×8^(.3/1.3)=484.7598K
  2. win=(1.3/.3)×.287×300×[8^(.3/1.3)−1]=229.7797kJ/kg
  3. Indicated ideal-model power=.1×229.7797=22.9780kW
  4. Isothermal minimum under stated endpoints= .287×300×ln8=179.0399kJ/kg

Common Mistake / શરતો

Values assumed constant-property polytropic modelના છે,measured compressor map નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Isothermal efficiency=ideal isothermal work/actual indicated input for matched mass and endpoints. Mechanical efficiency=indicated power/shaft input power.

For an approximately adiabatic compressor, isentropic efficiency=(h2s−h1)/(h2actual−h1).It compares actual outlet with an isentropic outlet at the same exit pressure.

Application / illustration

If indicated power23kW and mechanical efficiency.85, shaft power=23/.85=27.0588kW.

Common mistake / conditions

Name each efficiency and identify input/output boundaries; “compressor efficiency” alone is ambiguous.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Matched mass,endpoints માટે isothermal efficiency=ideal isothermal work/actual indicated input.Mechanical efficiency=indicated power/shaft input power.

Approximately adiabatic compressorમાં isentropic efficiency=(h2s−h1)/(h2actual−h1).Same exit pressure પર actual,isentropic outlet સરખાવે.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Indicated power23kW,mechanical efficiency.85 હોય તો shaft power=23/.85=27.0588kW.

Common Mistake / શરતો

દરેક efficiencyનું નામ,boundaries આપો;ફક્ત “compressor efficiency” ambiguous છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Volumetric efficiency is fresh air intake volume evaluated at stated suction conditions divided by swept volume. For the ideal clearance-only model:C=Vclearance/Vswept, eta v=1+C−C(p2/p1)^(1/nreexp).

Understand why

More clearance or a larger pressure ratio generally reduces this ideal intake fraction. Real heating, valve losses, leakage and intake reference conventions add effects.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not identify volumetric efficiency with thermal efficiency; and do not confuse free-air delivery referenced to specified ambient conditions with swept volume.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Volumetric efficiency stated suction conditionsના fresh intake volume/swept volume છે.Ideal clearance-only modelમાં C=Vclearance/Vswept,eta v=1+C−C(p2/p1)^(1/nreexp).

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

વધુ clearance કે pressure ratioથી ideal intake fraction સામાન્ય રીતે ઘટે.Real heating,valve losses,leakage,intake reference conventionsની વધારાની અસર છે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Volumetric efficiencyને thermal efficiency ન માનો;specified ambient referenceનું free-air delivery,swept volume સાથે ન ભેળવો.

body.en:
Given and model

C.05, ratio8, nreexp1.3; Vswept.01m³/cycle, single-acting300cycles/min.

Step-by-step solution

  1. eta v=1.05−.05×8^(1/1.3)=.8024547≈80.2455%
  2. Suction intake rate=.8024547×.01×300=2.40736m³/min

Common mistake / conditions

A double-acting cylinder needs the correct active swept volumes and rod-side correction; do not blindly multiply every given flow by2.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

C.05,ratio8,nreexp1.3;Vswept.01m³/cycle,single-acting300cycles/min.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. eta v=1.05−.05×8^(1/1.3)=.8024547≈80.2455%
  2. Suction intake rate=.8024547×.01×300=2.40736m³/min

Common Mistake / શરતો

Double-actingમાં correct active swept volumes,rod-side correction જોઈએ;દરેક flowને આંધળો2થી ન ગુણો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Air is partly compressed, cooled between stages, then compressed to final pressure; cooling reduces next-stage specific volume/work.

Construction:part and purpose

A low-pressure(LP) cylinder handles the large inlet volume.

An intercooler transfers heat to air/water without intentional mixing.

A moisture separator/drain manages condensate as designed.

A high-pressure(HP) cylinder handles smaller compressed volume.

Rated interstage piping, instruments and protective devices maintain safe limits.

Working:flow and reason

LP stage raises pressure fromp1 topi.

Intercooler removes heat; perfect intercooling ideally returns air toT1 with no pressure drop.

Separate condensed moisture through the specified system before HP entry.

HP stage raisespi top2; sum the work inputs of both stages.

Actual pressure loss, incomplete cooling and unequal stage behaviour change optimum performance.

Common mistake / conditions

Without intercooling a simple split alone does not deliver the ideal cooling-related work saving. In the equal-n, perfect-cooling, no-loss model, minimum work haspi=sqrt(p1p2).
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Air પહેલાં partly compress,stages વચ્ચે cool,પછી final pressure સુધી compress થાય;coolingથી next-stage specific volume/work ઘટે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Low-pressure(LP) cylinder મોટું inlet volume લે.

Intercooler intentional mixing વગર heat air/waterમાં આપે.

Designed moisture separator/drain condensate સંભાળે.

High-pressure(HP) cylinder નાનું compressed volume લે.

Rated interstage piping,instruments,protective devices safe limits જાળવે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

LP stage p1થી pi pressure વધારે.

Intercooler heat કાઢે;perfect intercoolingમાં no pressure drop સાથે air T1 સુધી આવે.

Specified systemથી HP પહેલાં condensed moisture અલગ કરો.

HP stage piથી p2 કરે;બન્ને stagesના work inputs ઉમેરો.

Actual pressure loss,incomplete cooling,unequal stage behaviour optimum performance બદલે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Intercooling વગર ફક્ત splitથી ideal cooling-related saving નથી મળતી.Equal n,perfect cooling,no-loss modelમાં minimum work માટે pi=sqrt(p1p2).

body.en:
Definition / principle

Several cylinders/stages share the total pressure ratio but the interstage gas is not deliberately cooled back to suction temperature.

Construction:part and purpose

LP stage compresses the initial larger volume.

An interstage duct connects LP delivery to HP suction without an intercooler.

HP stage and any further stages raise pressure to the specified final value.

Valves, instruments, cooling of machine parts and protection remain necessary.

Working:flow and reason

Compress fromp1 topi in the first stage.

Pass the hot interstage air to the next inlet, allowing for real losses.

Continue compression from the higher inlet temperature.

For ideal continuous equal-n compression without cooling, stage work sums to the corresponding single-polytropic-path work; staging alone is not the intercooling saving.

Common mistake / conditions

Staging may still meet mechanical/pressure constraints; do not equate its purpose solely with ideal energy reduction.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

અનેક cylinders/stages total ratio share કરે,પણ interstage gasને suction temperature સુધી deliberately cool નથી કરાતું.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

LP stage શરૂઆતનું મોટું volume compress કરે.

Interstage duct intercooler વગર LP deliveryને HP suction સાથે જોડે.

HP/વધુ stages final specified pressure આપે.

Valves,instruments,machine-part cooling,protection જરૂરી રહે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

First stageમાં p1થી pi compress કરો.

Real losses સાથે hot interstage air next inletમાં જાય.

Higher inlet temperatureથી compression આગળ ચાલે.

Ideal continuous equal-n,no-coolingમાં total work corresponding single-polytropic path જેટલું;ફક્ત stagingથી intercooling saving નહિ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Staging mechanical/pressure constraints માટે પણ હોય;ફક્ત ideal energy saving તેનો હેતુ નહિ.

body.en:
Given and model

p1=1bar, p2=9bar absolute, T1=300K, n1.3, R.287; perfect intercooling, identical stage model, no pressure loss.

Step-by-step solution

  1. pi=sqrt(1×9)=3bar; each stage ratio3
  2. w2stage=2×(1.3/.3)×.287×300×[3^(.3/1.3)−1]=215.3240kJ/kg
  3. Single-stage work=(1.3/.3)×.287×300×[9^(.3/1.3)−1]=246.3911kJ/kg

Common mistake / conditions

The geometric-mean pressure result requires the listed conditions, not every real compressor installation.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

p1=1bar,p2=9bar absolute,T1=300K,n1.3,R.287;perfect intercooling,identical stage model,no pressure loss.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. pi=sqrt(1×9)=3bar;each stage ratio3
  2. w2stage=2×(1.3/.3)×.287×300×[3^(.3/1.3)−1]=215.3240kJ/kg
  3. Single-stage work=(1.3/.3)×.287×300×[9^(.3/1.3)−1]=246.3911kJ/kg

Common Mistake / શરતો

Geometric-mean pressure result listed conditionsમાં જ,દરેક real installationમાં નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Counter-rotating lobes transfer trapped volumes from inlet to outlet; pressure equalisation mainly occurs on connection to the discharge side.

Construction:part and purpose

A casing encloses two accurately shaped rotors.

Timing gears maintain phase/clearance without intended rotor contact.

Ports open trapped pockets to inlet/discharge.

Bearings, seals and rated drive/protection support rotation.

Working:flow and reason

Rotor pockets fill at the inlet.

Lobes carry air around the casing, not through the lobe contact region.

The trapped pocket reaches the outlet and meets higher pressure.

Air is discharged; leakage, backflow and pulsation affect efficiency/noise.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not describe a conventional Roots machine as having the same progressive internal pocket-volume reduction as a screw compressor.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Counter-rotating lobes trapped volumes inletથી outlet લઈ જાય;discharge સાથે જોડાતાં મુખ્ય pressure equalisation થાય.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Casing બે shaped rotors પકડે.

Timing gears phase/clearance જાળવે,intended rotor contact વગર.

Ports trapped pocketsને inlet/discharge સાથે જોડે.

Bearings,seals,rated drive/protection rotationને ટેકો આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Inlet પર rotor pockets ભરાય.

Lobes airને casing આસપાસ લઈ જાય,lobe contact regionમાંથી નહિ.

Pocket outlet પર higher pressure મળે.

Air discharge થાય;leakage,backflow,pulsation efficiency/noiseને અસર કરે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Conventional Rootsમાં screw જેવી progressive internal pocket-volume reduction છે એમ ન કહો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

An eccentric rotor with sliding vanes creates pockets that expand at inlet and contract toward discharge.

Construction:part and purpose

A circular casing surrounds an off-centre slotted rotor.

Vanes slide in rotor slots to follow the wall as designed.

Inlet/outlet ports match the pocket-volume changes.

Lubrication/sealing, cooling, bearings and drive follow the particular design.

Working:flow and reason

Increasing pocket volume draws air through the inlet.

Air is trapped after inlet closure.

Eccentric geometry reduces pocket volume and raises pressure.

Pocket opens to discharge and releases air; the next pocket repeats.

Common mistake / conditions

Vane wear, clearance, oil contamination and overheating affect performance; not all vane machines are oil-free.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Sliding vanesવાળો eccentric rotor inlet પાસે expanding,outlet તરફ contracting pockets બનાવે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Circular casing off-centre slotted rotorને ઘેરે.

Vanes slotsમાં slide થઈ designed wall following કરે.

Inlet/outlet ports pocket-volume changes સાથે મેળ ખાય.

Lubrication/sealing,cooling,bearings,drive particular design મુજબ હોય.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Increasing pocket volumeથી inlet air ખેંચાય.

Inlet બંધ થતાં air trap થાય.

Eccentric geometry pocket volume ઘટાડે,pressure વધારે.

Pocket dischargeમાં ખૂલી air છોડે;next pocket repeat કરે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Vane wear,clearance,oil contamination,overheating અસર કરે;બધા vane machines oil-free નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Meshing helical rotors trap air and reduce its volume along the rotor length.

Construction:part and purpose

A casing houses matched male/female rotors.

Helical profiles create moving compression chambers.

Inlet/discharge ports determine filling and built-in volume ratio.

Bearings, seals, cooling and either oil injection/separation or qualified dry design complete the system.

Working:flow and reason

Air fills spaces at the inlet end.

Rotor engagement seals the volume from inlet.

Volume decreases as the trapped chamber moves axially.

Compressed air leaves at discharge; oil-injected units require designed oil separation/cooling.

Common mistake / conditions

Port timing and built-in ratio must match duty reasonably; “screw” does not automatically mean oil-free delivery.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Meshing helical rotors air trap કરી rotor lengthમાં તેનું volume ઘટાડે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Casing matched male/female rotors ધરાવે.

Helical profiles moving compression chambers બનાવે.

Ports filling,built-in volume ratio નક્કી કરે.

Bearings,seals,cooling અને oil injection/separation કે qualified dry design system પૂરી કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Inlet end પર spacesમાં air ભરાય.

Rotor engagement volumeને inletથી seal કરે.

Chamber axially ખસે ત્યારે volume ઘટે.

Dischargeથી compressed air નીકળે;oil-injectedમાં designed oil separation/cooling જોઈએ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Port timing,built-in ratio duty સાથે મેળ ખાવા જોઈએ;“screw” એટલે oil-free delivery નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A fixed scroll and an orbiting scroll form sealed pockets that move inward and shrink.

Construction:part and purpose

Two interleaved spiral scrolls define chambers.

An eccentric drive creates orbital motion.

An anti-rotation device prevents the orbiting scroll simply spinning.

Seals, bearings, inlet and central discharge complete the air path.

Working:flow and reason

Air enters outer pockets.

Orbiting motion closes the pockets.

Pockets move inward and reduce volume, raising pressure.

Air exits at the central discharge and the next pockets fill.

Common mistake / conditions

Orbiting is not the same as continuous self-rotation; seal and temperature limits govern application.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Fixed અને orbiting scroll sealed pocketsને અંદર ખસેડી નાના કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

બે interleaved spiral scrolls chambers બનાવે.

Eccentric drive orbital motion આપે.

Anti-rotation device orbiting scrollને ફક્ત spin થતું અટકાવે.

Seals,bearings,inlet,central discharge air path પૂરો કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Air outer pocketsમાં આવે.

Orbiting motion pockets બંધ કરે.

Pockets અંદર ખસી volume ઘટાડે,pressure વધારે.

Central dischargeથી air જાય,next pockets ભરાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Orbiting,continuous self-rotation એક નથી;seal,temperature limits application નક્કી કરે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

An impeller adds energy and velocity to air; diffusion converts part of the velocity into static pressure.

Construction:part and purpose

An inlet guides air toward the impeller eye.

A rotating impeller accelerates air outward.

A diffuser slows flow to recover pressure.

A collector/volute, shaft, bearings and control system deliver stable flow.

Working:flow and reason

Air enters near the rotation axis.

Impeller transfers shaft work and increases total enthalpy.

Diffuser converts kinetic energy to pressure with losses.

Collector delivers air; staging raises the overall pressure ratio.

Common mistake / conditions

Surge and choke limit the operating map; anti-surge controls and manufacturer limits are essential, not optional throttling guesses.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Impeller airમાં energy,velocity ઉમેરે;diffusionથી velocityનો ભાગ static pressure બને.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Inlet airને impeller eye તરફ લાવે.

Rotating impeller air બહાર accelerate કરે.

Diffuser flow ધીમો કરી pressure recover કરે.

Collector/volute,shaft,bearings,control system stable flow આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Air rotation axis નજીક પ્રવેશે.

Impeller shaft work આપી total enthalpy વધારે.

Diffuser losses સાથે kinetic energyને pressureમાં ફેરવે.

Collector air આપે;staging overall pressure ratio વધારે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Surge,choke operating map limit કરે;anti-surge controls,manufacturer limits જરૂરી છે,અંદાજી throttling નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Alternating rotor/stator rows raise pressure while the main flow proceeds approximately along the axis.

Construction:part and purpose

Rotor blade rows receive shaft work.

Stators guide/diffuse flow and set the next rotor inlet direction.

A casing, annulus and hub define the passage.

Shaft, bearings, variable guide/bleed controls as designed support operation.

Working:flow and reason

Air passes through inlet guidance.

Each rotor adds energy and changes velocity.

Each stator recovers static pressure/guides the next stage.

Many stages develop the required pressure ratio within stall/surge constraints.

Common mistake / conditions

Stators do not add shaft work like rotors; blade stall, foreign-object damage and fouling matter in service.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Alternating rotor/stator rows pressure વધારે,main flow લગભગ axis સાથે આગળ જાય.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Rotor blade rows shaft work લે.

Stators flow guide/diffuse કરી next rotor inlet direction આપે.

Casing,annulus,hub passage બનાવે.

Shaft,bearings,designed variable guide/bleed controls operationને ટેકો આપે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Air inlet guidanceમાંથી જાય.

દરેક rotor energy ઉમેરે,velocity બદલે.

દરેક stator static pressure recover/next stage guide કરે.

અનેક stages stall/surge constraintsમાં required ratio આપે.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Stators rotorsની જેમ shaft work નથી ઉમેરતા;blade stall,foreign-object damage,fouling મહત્વનાં છે.

h.en: 2.2.7 Selection, maintenance reasoning and exam answer

body.en:
Write a strong exam answer

  1. Start with flow and pressure at stated reference conditions; specify duty cycle, air quality, drying, noise, cooling and energy consumption; match a qualified performance map.
  2. For construction questions draw ports, moving parts and flow arrows; explain how volume/velocity changes produce pressure; add applications and limitations.
  3. For calculations state absolute ratios, temperature inK, compression exponent, clearance assumptions and which power/efficiency is required.
Does intercooling always increase total plant efficiency?

It reduces ideal staged compression work under the stated model, but cooling auxiliaries, pressure loss and the whole plant balance must also be counted.
body.gu:
Exam Answer મજબૂત ગોઠવીએ

  1. Stated reference conditionsમાં flow,pressureથી શરૂ કરો;duty cycle,air quality,drying,noise,cooling,energy જણાવો;qualified map match કરો.
  2. Constructionમાં ports,moving parts,flow arrows દોરો;volume/velocity changeથી pressure કેમ બને તે સમજાવો;applications,limitations ઉમેરો.
  3. Calculationsમાં absolute ratios,Kમાં temperature,exponent,clearance assumptions,required power/efficiencyનું નામ આપો.
Intercoolingથી હંમેશાં Total Plant Efficiency વધે?

Stated modelમાં ideal staged compression work ઘટે,પણ cooling auxiliaries,pressure loss,whole plant balance પણ ગણવા પડે.
